coverage.scope: All star matchings modulo permitted root relabellings. The remaining edges are still variables; these cases are not complete graphs.

scope:
Eight unseeded global models using the necessary existence of c(L)<=3.

The root is not required to lie on L. The eight relative positions form
a complete cover before any additional root-template normalization. All
84x84 unknown adjacencies are variable. No local witness, Gram, matching
template, automorphism, or prism budget at the selected line is assumed.
This finite specification has no proved affordable running time.

small_line.scope:
At most m connected components in the neighbourhood of a fixed line.

A rooted forest witnesses the bound. Each member has one parent or is
a root, parent edges belong to the actual graph, and depths strictly
increase. At most m roots are allowed. This is equivalent to c(L)<=m;
there is no assumption about the sizes or isomorphism types of components.
